findings.message:
Task acceptance not fulfilled: the review found that the candidate does not satisfy source issue #317. Change the candidate so it satisfies everything the issue requires; the reviewer's acceptance evidence:
- The new branches retain `target.pr` for `existingHeadContinuationShape` records in `observeReview` and `requestReviewFor`, and the added test proves those two paths republish after retirement.
- `recoverClosedReviewWait` (`src/repair/loop-review-recovery.ts:97-106`) still calls `retireClosedPublication` for a preserved-null record with a `review_pending` wait and `review_request` intent at `work`.
- `reconcilePublishIntent` (`src/repair/loop-publication.ts:590-600`) still retires a preserved-null record's closed PR while recovering an ambiguous `review_request` intent.
- Both leave `target.pr` null with no intent and `candidateState.publishedHead === head`, so the `(pr === null && record.intent === null)` guard in `recoverClosedExistingHead` still defers forever.

[P1] Remaining closed-publication retire paths still strand preserved-null rows

The new branch only covers the direct review observation and freshness paths. A preserved-null record can still reach `retireClosedPublication` through `recoverClosedReviewWait` (`src/repair/loop-review-recovery.ts:97-106`, for a `review_pending` wait plus `review_request` intent at `work`) and through `reconcilePublishIntent` (`src/repair/loop-publication.ts:590-600`, while recovering an ambiguous `review_request` intent). Both clear `target.pr` and the intent while leaving `candidateState.publishedHead === head`, so `recoverClosedExistingHead` still refuses at `src/repair/loop-existing-head-continuation.ts:119-122`; rows already in that retired state are not repaired either. Apply the same `existingHeadContinuationShape` guard at those retire sites, or make the continuation accept the durable `retiredOwnPr` marker.
